stances.quote: Six months later, 18 servicemembers are dead, hundreds more are wounded, and American taxpayers have spent billions of dollars on a war that has not made them safer and that has only raised their prices at home.
stances.reasoning: Text repeatedly criticizes billions spent on Iran war and calls for ending funding for military adventurism.

stances.quote: Americans won’t forget that Republicans cut healthcare to pass a massive tax cut for big corporations and the wealthiest Americans.
stances.reasoning: Explicit opposition to tax cuts for corporations and wealthy indicates stance against lower taxes.
